basics.name: Matías Ezequiel Di muro
basics.label: SAP BTP Senior Developer | AI Engineer
basics.summary: SAP BTP Developer specialized in AI, designing and building intelligent, robust solutions around AI models: from LLMs and agents to other machine learning capabilities.//Hands-on experience building agents and integrating LLMs into real-world projects with solid engineering practices, leveraging SAP AI Core and Generative AI Hub for model orchestration, Grounding Service and SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine for retrieval anchored in enterprise data, Document Information Extraction for intelligent document processing, and Joule Studio in SAP Build for low-code agent development delivered through Joule.//Strong software engineering foundation, with design patterns, architectural best practices and clean code as everyday standards. Solid full stack experience on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry) with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, SAP CAP (CDS), SAP HANA and Fiori / UI5, integrating with ERPs and on-premise systems through Cloud Connector, securing with XSUAA and SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS), and automating processes with SAP Build Process Automation.

work.name: Accenture Argentina
work.summary: Full stack developer focused on AI-driven process automation, building agents and LLM-based solutions on SAP BTP. I design and develop AI agents and LLM-powered automations for enterprise processes, combining low-code with Joule Studio and custom backends in TypeScript, Node.js, LangGraph/LangChain and SAP AI Core, integrating tools and context through Model Context Protocol (MCP). I deliver full stack solutions on SAP BTP, from backend services to Fiori / UI5 interfaces, applying software engineering best practices across the entire lifecycle (clean code, architecture, monitoring, auditing and reliability) within SOX-regulated environments. I also contribute to the team's technical growth through talks, proposals and by introducing new AI technologies and practices such as agents, MCP and engineering best practices.

work.name: Hexagon Consulting
work.summary: I trained in SAP Fiori UI5 framework to work as a Frontend developer. I participated in various internal web application projects, gaining more experience with each one. Months later, I started training as a Backend developer, where I worked for external clients, mainly using NodeJS, Express, Typescript, SAP HANA (relational database), SAP CAP CDS, SAP BPA (Build Process Automation), SAP Workflow Management, Cloud Connector for on premise systems, SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS), and XSUAA (SAP Authorization & Trust Management Service). Additionally, during this time, I learned fundamental aspects of SAP BTP management.

awards.title: Technology Skills 2026 - SAP BTP Gen AI and Agentic AI Workshop
awards.summary: This badge validates that the earner has successfully completed the SAP BTP Generative AI and Agentic AI Workshop, including all required hands-on labs. The learner demonstrated practical proficiency in SAP BTP AI services, generative AI integration, and agentic solution design, and is equipped to initiate and implement AI-driven architectures and use cases within SAP BTP projects following recommended best practices.

awards.title: Awards and Recognition 2026 - SAP Global Business AI Agent Hackathon Participant
awards.summary: Awarded to individuals who were hand-selected to participate in the SAP Global Business AI Agent Hackathon 2026. This badge validates the end-to-end skills required to build production-ready AI agents on SAP BTP using Joule Studio, translating complex business challenges into high-impact AI solutions. Participants completed a rigorous 4-week program, moving from concept to a functional demo. This earner was part of an exclusive group.

awards.title: Hack2Build - Hackathon Finalist Award
awards.summary: This award is given to individuals who successfully participated as a member of a team representing a company in Hack2Build virtual/hybrid event from SAP, where company teams compete to design, build, and present solutions addressing a business challenge or a pressing issue.
